precepts.text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star.
precepts.point: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star. So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. But why is it referring to Lucifer as the morning star?
precepts.why:
“We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star: Christ, the day star that arises in your hearts.

Then why is the king of Babylon, America, referred to as Lucifer? Because “such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” “And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” The white man came and taught another Christ and transformed himself into an apostle of Christ. America transformed itself in the 1950s into a God-loving Christian nation, and for the last seventy years has pushed that it is here to set up righteousness and justice on the earth, after murdering, stealing, colonizing and enslaving millions of people.

That is why Isaiah calls him “Lucifer, son of the morning”: he says he is Christian, righteous, the light, and makes himself look like the morning star. But Christ is the real morning star, “the true Light”, and the day star Peter speaks of arises in the hearts of those who take heed to the sure word of prophecy.

precepts.text: My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. As you are preparing your soul, that is the Lord trying you to make sure you are worthy of that calling. It was already discussed in the heavens to bring you in; it is up to us to stay diligent and steadfast, and not get pulled off by sin, because we are a chosen vessel. You have to see yourselves that way.
precepts.point: Video played: the old United Negro College Fund commercial, "A mind is a terrible thing to waste." The mind of the Israelites, men and women, is a precious thing. For the Lord to call you out of darkness into his marvelous light is because you have a mind to do great things. We have known many brothers and sisters that came in with good gifts they could have dedicated to the Lord's nation, then got weak hearted, went back out into the world, and are doing nothing. This was the time to shine.

note.label: The Developmental Psychology of Being Hated

precepts.why:
The Lord is “not willing that any should perish”, so any one of us that comes into this truth, the desire is for you to make it. Peter says “give diligence to make your calling and election sure”. The Most High called you sisters and you brothers in here, and that was not a waste. It was made to happen in the heavens when it was time for you to wake up. Just as there was a conversation in the heavens about Job, when Satan wanted to tempt him, there were conversations about you repenting. That's some love right there. Understand that sacred calling.

Then Sirach: “My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation.” He wants to try you to make sure you are fit for the kingdom. But he first selected you. He brought you into his marvellous gospel to wake you up and bring you up as princes and princesses; no longer are you to be on the dunghill. As you prepare your soul for temptation, that is the Lord trying you to make sure you are worthy of that calling.

It was already discussed in the heavens to bring you in, so it is up to us to stay diligent and steadfast, and not get pulled off by evil, wickedness, sin, temptations and the things our people get caught up in. We are a chosen vessel, and you have to see yourselves that way.

Peter goes on, “for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall”: that is the guarantee of keeping God's commandments. So why squander the chance Christ died to give you because of some bad habits and temptations? Every one of your spirits is precious to the Most High, and it hurts leadership to see you get weak and lose the faith. A mind is a terrible thing to waste. Many brothers and sisters came in with good gifts, got weak hearted, went back out, and are doing nothing. This was the time to shine.

precepts.text: Partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world through lust; add to your faith virtue, knowledge, temperance, patience, godliness, brotherly kindness, charity. Knowing that Christ is black is not enough; add to your repertoire. If these abound you shall not be barren nor unfruitful, and you will not be purged out. He that lacketh them is blind, cannot see afar off that America is destroyed and salvation is coming, and has forgotten he was purged from his old sins. Keep trimming or you end up back in the old folly.
precepts.point: The fear is not the fear of the servant who hid his talent or the brother making excuses because he is nervous; Psalms 119:120, my flesh trembleth for fear of thee and I am afraid of thy judgments. He is the King of terrors.
precepts.why:
“Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.” That escape from corruption is the purging of iniquity in Proverbs 16:6, and it has to be kept up.

“And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue.” We have to be diligent. We cannot just come in here knowing that Christ is black, God is black and the angels are black. When we come through these doors we have to add to our repertoire, add to our spirit: “virtue; and to virtue knowledge; And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness; And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.”

“For if these things be in you, and abound”: not just be in you, but be in you and grow. “they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.” Meaning you do not have to be purged out. If you can do that, you do not have to worry about being taken out of the mix, because you are constantly growing and doing the Lord’s will.

“But he that lacketh these things is blind.” Sin has blinded you. You cannot think straight, you cannot do what is common sense, you struggle constantly and never break through, because you have not purged yourself from the wrong people and you love that pleasure more than God. He “cannot see afar off”: you cannot see that America is going to be destroyed and that salvation is coming. You are a situational Israelite living in the moment, thinking America is going to last forever. Shame.

He “hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.” God purged you from your old sins, but if you do not keep trimming, if you do not keep purging, you will end up back in your old folly. This is a wake-up call, a punch in the gut: come up out of the foolishness.

precepts.text: A more sure word of prophecy, whereunto ye do well to take heed, as a light shining in a dark place. We are that light; through our example we win our people, whether in DC, New Orleans, California, or the UK. No prophecy is of private interpretation; holy black and Hispanic men of God spake as moved by the Holy Ghost.
precepts.point: I will yet make doctrine to shine as the morning and pour out doctrine as prophecy, and leave it to all ages for ever. I have not laboured for myself only, but for all them that seek wisdom. We do not do this work for ourselves.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
“I will yet make doctrine to shine as the morning, and will send forth her light afar off.” Peter says, “We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed”. Take heed to do what the scriptures say. The Most High called us into this truth, so we have to take heed.

“as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. We are that light shining in a dark place. That is why Christ said, let your light so shine before men. We have to be that example for our people, to win them over into the faith. Whether you are in DC, New Orleans, California or the UK, the Most High chose us, and through our example we have to win our people over.

“Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation. For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.” Prophecy is the foretelling of future events in the Bible, and it did not come by the will of man. Holy men of God, holy black men, holy Hispanic men, spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost. That is the light sent forth afar off.

precepts.text: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises, that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust; and beside this, giving all diligence. You are supposed to be escaping the worldly elements, looking across the aisle for righteousness, not her behind. When we announce marriages we say this is the day the Lord has made between you two, with the angels in agreement and a whole community behind you.
precepts.point: Romans 13:10: love worketh no ill to his neighbour. If you love the sister, how did you use ill means to get her? The law you broke was going around the father and the leadership and tricking her. If a sister has an actual father, he makes the decision on the brother who did this evil; if it is up to us, we are not signing it or blessing it, and we will tell him why.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
To covet is not simply to desire. It is to want what belongs to another inordinately: you violate God's laws to get it. “Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s”. The daughter belongs under the father just like everything else in his house. Go around him to get her, never telling the fathers or the elders, and you have coveted. To entice is to allure, to bait, to induce to evil; it is trickery and deception. “My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not”. And “Love worketh no ill to his neighbour”: if you love the sister, how did you use ill means to get her?

Peter shows what we are supposed to be doing instead: “Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. And beside this, giving all diligence”.

As brothers and sisters come in here, you are supposed to be escaping these worldly elements and truly repenting. When you look across the aisle, you are supposed to be looking for righteousness, not just her behind. Taking your sister for lust is the corruption that is in the world, and the same thing goes on on the other side. A man who talks to you under cover, without your father and without the leadership, does not have good intentions; the fact that he didn't do it the right way shows you where his mind is.

Do it with diligence, the right way. When we announce our marriages we say, this is the day the Lord has made between you two; you can bring forth righteousness right here, and the Lord, the angels and everybody are in agreement with it. When you do things the right way, you have a whole community behind you. The fathers and the elders have the vantage point: we see down the road where it is going, and we make the decision as fathers.

precepts.text: Add to your faith virtue, knowledge, temperance, patience, godliness, brotherly kindness, charity. Knowledge means learning to break the scriptures down, because the camp will not be on social media forever, and a brother who will not come around the deacons and bishops to learn will not last. If these things be in you and abound, ye shall be neither barren nor unfruitful; abound means they stay, because a brother of seven years with green leaves can be offended and stop bearing fruit. He that lacketh these things is blind and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
precepts.point: Against such there is no law, because you are keeping the law. These are the fruits that develop once the word dwells in you.
precepts.why:
“But the fruit of the Spirit is love”: keeping the commandments. Joy: do you have joy in keeping God's commandments, or are you always sad and depressed? Peace with your wife and with the brothers and sisters, not always arguing and fighting. Longsuffering is patience. Gentleness means being right with your brother; it does not mean you have to be soft and act like a sodomite. Faith is believing what the Bible says. Temperance is self-control, not easily provoked. “against such there is no law”, because you are keeping the law. These fruits develop once the word of God dwells in you.

Peter shows the same fruits: “And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge”. Knowledge means learning the scriptures and learning how to break them down, because we are not going to be on social media all the time. Brothers who will not come around the deacons, bishops and officers to learn the knowledge of God are not going to last in this truth. “And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness; And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity”: loving God with all your heart and your brother as yourself. All of these are the fruits your tree must bring forth.

“For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.” Abound means they stay in you. These things can be in you and then leave you. A brother or sister can be among us six or seven years, growing, the leaves green, and then somebody offends them and all of a sudden they stop bearing fruit.

“But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.” So examine yourself: am I bearing good fruit? The Lord does not tell you how long he will be patient. A fig tree that bears no fruit is cut down, and a branch that does not abide in Christ withers and is cast into the fire.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 11: David Anointed and His Mighty Men

precepts.why:
“Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall”. The word must be gone over constantly.

Eleazar the son of Dodo, “one of the three mighties”, stood with David where the Philistines gathered in a parcel of ground full of barley, and “the people fled from before the Philistines.” But “they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.” The Most High was working with these brothers to make them mighty.

When we go into the street it is not a physical war, but we are to stand against three hundred with the word. This is why we must study, and make our calling and election sure.

precepts.text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; the testimony of the Lord is sure.
precepts.point: The testimony of the Lord is sure; the testimonies and prophecies in this Bible are sure.

note.label: Psalm 19: The Perfect Law That Converts the Soul

precepts.why:
“the testimony of the Lord is sure”. Peter says it the same way: “We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”.

The testimonies and prophecies in this Bible are sure. We have a more sure word of prophecy, and we do well to take heed to it as a light shining in a dark place.

precepts.text: We have a more sure word of prophecy; no prophecy of scripture is of any private interpretation, for holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
precepts.point: Kings of armies did flee, and she that tarried at home divided the spoil. Though they lay among the pots, yet shall they be as the wings of a dove covered with silver.
precepts.why:
“The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.” That is why you have different books of people that the Lord spoke to: Ezekiel, Jeremiah and all the prophets in the company of Israel that published what God said. Peter says, “We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”.

“Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation. For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.” The company that published the word did not speak from their own will or private interpretation; the Lord gave the word, and holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

precepts.why: “Give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall”: a lot of you ask what you need to do to endure to the end; the secret is right there. Always have a ready mind to stand fast and do the work in this truth. If you have the skill, do it, and be diligent about it.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 3 A Message to The 7 Churches

precepts.why:
“And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue;” Add to your faith virtue. “and to virtue knowledge;” That is very important in all the congregations. “And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness; And to godliness brotherly kindness;” You see that: a lot of brothers that left out of the truth fell off at that part, brotherly kindness. “and to brotherly kindness charity.” Charity, loving your neighbour. “For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.” So you want to know how you can keep continuing in this truth? Giving all diligence, that is number one; add to your faith virtue, and to virtue knowledge, and to knowledge temperance, and to temperance patience, and to patience godliness, and to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness charity. If these things be in you and abound, they make you that you shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Watch the next verse: “But he that lacketh these things is blind,” Those brothers and sisters that ran up out of here traitorously are blind. “and cannot see afar off,” You cannot see afar off. “and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.” You forgot you were purged from your old sins, so what have you done now? Gone right back to your evil, right back. Who is saying that? The Lord is speaking there, so get mad with God. That hurt? I hope so.

points: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation. No prophecy of the scriptures is of any private interpretation, meaning there is no personal interpretation. Oh, I interpret it this way and you interpret it that way. No, there is one way to understand the Bible. And that one way is the spirit of God that will come in you and make you understand it. So knowing this first: before you start reading, understand that no prophecy is of any private or personal interpretation.

For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost. So the spirit of the Lord came into holy men and they wrote down things that the Lord showed them, that are going to take place in the future. What is going to happen to the children of Israel, and kingdoms that are going to rise up on this earth, and events that are going to take place on this earth before Christ returns. The prophets wrote it down.

Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall. Give diligence. Since we live in a time at war of ignorance, brother, you have to give diligence to your calling.

Read in class: To give diligence to make your calling secure is an invitation to zealously live out your God-given purpose. In the biblical context of 2 Peter 1:10, believers are urged to put in intentional and energetic effort, to practise virtues like faith, goodness, knowledge, self-control and love.

The result of diligence: practising these traits protects a person from becoming spiritually blind or forgetting their purpose. The verse promises that actively reinforcing your faith with these character traits provides more stability and assurance, ensuring you will never fall. Never fall from your purpose.

All of us that have been ordained prophets by God to save the people, our calling and election is made sure by teaching them, by saving them, by prophesying, by doing the work. That is how we make our calling and election sure, on top of keeping the commandments. Keeping the commandments is good, that is our purpose of life, you are supposed to do that. But you are on another mission as a soldier of God. Wake up the people. Save them. Give them warning. So give diligence to that, and make your calling and election sure.

And an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. You will hear the words when your mission is done: well done, thou good and faithful servant, enter thou into the joy of thy Lord. Because you as a brother, a soldier, a prophet of God, gave diligence to the mission that was at hand when you were upon the earth.

Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure. Only you can make your calling and election sure. How? Keeping the commandments, dealing right with each other, and understanding your purpose. Sit down and ask yourself: what can I do to help build this nation? What gifts do I have?

There is a lot that has to be done, and we have to take it to another level and separate ourselves from this system. Why are we buying chickens from the store? Why every Passover are we buying lambs from these farmers? Why do we not have our own land, and we are talking about being a nation within a nation? Are we really a nation if we depend on everybody for everything? God is going to give some of you the gift to go into farming.

No prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation. The prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost. So much for personal revelation.
